transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ____. What brings you in today?

Well... just having some trouble at work, I guess. Like, I'll start a safety briefing or a plan review, and I try hard to pay attention. But... give it a few minutes and my mind is off on three other job problems. I end up missing things I know I should've caught. So... that's why I'm here.
Did you have these concentration problems as a child?

Yeah, I guess so. I mean... my parents heard about it a lot, back in elementary school. Teachers always saying I wouldn't stay in my seat, or I was talking when I shouldn't be. Stuff like that. I'd lose my homework, or just... rush through the instructions before I really knew what I was supposed to be doing. So, yeah. It's been around a while.
Do you also find it hard to sit still?

Yeah, I suppose. I mean... if there's a meeting, and everyone else is just sitting there the whole time, I'm usually the guy who has to stand up. I'll go get coffee, or... step outside to check on something. Just... find some excuse to move around. Sitting still for long is... tough.
Have these attention and restlessness problems been present for at least six months?

Yeah... longer than six months. I'd say it's been really messing with my work for... about two years and a couple of months now. 

Just... the construction schedule changed back then, and the hours got pretty chaotic. So... yeah. It's been a while.
Do you find yourself worrying excessively about a lot of different things most days?
No... not really. I mean, I worry about getting the jobs done on time, but... that's just work. I wouldn't say I worry about a bunch of different things all the time.
